title: Strategic Management in Hospitality and Tourism

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the role of strategy in business and basic concepts related to strategic management.
Analyze internal and external environments using tools like STEEP and Porter's Five Forces.
Apply VRIO and SWOT analysis to assess competitive advantages and organizational capabilities.
Develop competitive strategies using models such as Porter's Generic Strategies and Bowman's Strategy Clock.
Evaluate strategic options using financial and non-financial criteria.
Implement strategic plans considering organizational resources, culture, and structure.
Analyze economic indicators and business performance in hospitality and tourism firms.
Conduct case study analysis applying strategic management theories and tools.
Demonstrate critical thinking in analyzing strategic issues and formulating solutions.
Communicate effectively in presenting strategic analyses and recommendations.
Engage in self-directed learning to deepen understanding of strategic management concepts.
